cards.verse_text: Are you not aware that I can call on My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
cards.snippet: …and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?

cards.verse_text: “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
cards.snippet: “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”

cards.card_text: The name Legion comes with a reason: they are ___.
cards.verse_text: “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
cards.snippet: “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”

cards.card_text: When the people reach Jesus, how do they find the man who had the legion of demons?
cards.verse_text: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons sitting there, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
cards.snippet: …to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons sitting there, clothed and in his right mind; and they…

cards.card_text: The man answers Jesus with the name “Legion” because many ___ had gone into him.
cards.verse_text: “Legion,” he replied, because many demons had gone into him.
cards.snippet: “Legion,” he replied, because many demons had gone into him.
